Q6097.reason: In most states 'to A and the heirs of his body' is a fee simple absolute, so the cousin took everything and the later deed left the niece nothing.

Q5137.reason: The opinion is admissible because physicians may rely on x-rays customarily used in medical practice even when those x-rays are not independently in evidence.

Q5526.reason: Only the late-evening break-in of the guest's hotel room has common-law breaking, entry, a dwelling, nighttime, and intent to commit a felony.
